title: teucrium scorodonia var. euganeum
intro: Teucrium scorodonia var. euganeum, commonly known as Western Woodland Germander, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Western Woodland Germander include its ability to modulate the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and exhibit hepatoprotective effects, making it a potential remedy for liver health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
